citeAs: Hoak, B., & McDaniel, P. (2025). On Synthetic Texture Datasets: Challenges, Creation, and Curation.
creator: Blaine Hoak, Patrick McDaniel (University of Wisconsin-Madison)
description: A texture dataset spanning 246,285 images across 56 texture classes, generated using text-to-image models to support texture-based tasks and measure texture bias.
name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
rai:dataBiases: A Fourier analysis was performed to ensure that the textures in the dataset are not overly biased towards a certain frequency and well capture the frequencies found in real data.
rai:dataCollection: Texture-specific prompts were produced using combinations of artistically-informed descriptors across 56 texture classes. These prompts were used as inputs to Stable Diffusion model pipelines to generate images. A three-stage refinement process (frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring) was then applied to filter the images.
rai:dataLimitations: Stable Diffusion models are not explicitly designed to create textures, so other kinds of images (e.g., objects) may arise during generation. Additionally, the safety filter flagged up to 60% of initial generated images as NSFW, particularly for certain texture descriptors like 'paisley', requiring these to be excluded.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: A multi-stage refinement process consisting of three filtering steps: (1) frequency filtering to remove object-like images by retaining the top 80% of images with the highest frequency cutoff threshold, (2) patch variance filtering to eliminate homogeneous images by filtering out the bottom 20% with the lowest mean patch variance, and (3) CLIP score filtering to ensure alignment with prompts by filtering out the bottom 20% of images with the lowest CLIP scores.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset contributes valuable resources for advancing interpretability, bias analysis, and robustness in machine learning, specifically by enabling the measurement of texture bias and its impact on model trustworthiness.
rai:dataUseCases: Interpreting the high-level features models learn, uncovering biases (specifically texture bias), and identifying security vulnerabilities.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Stable Diffusion (for image generation), CLIP (for scoring and filtering images)
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The Stable Diffusion content safety filter flagged many images as NSFW. Although no explicit content was found in flagged images, they were excluded from the final dataset for ethical reasons.
